## Overview
FastUMI-100K is a large-scale, high-quality UMI-style dataset designed for data-driven robotic manipulation learning. Featuring over **100K+ demonstration trajectories** across **54 diverse tasks** and hundreds of object types, the dataset provides multi-view wrist-mounted fisheye images and high-frequency end-effector states.
